 Successfully running Bachelor of Architecture programmes along with four robust Masters in Planning, Architecture, Environment and Interior Design, the institute is mentoring numerous PhD scholars also. Its unique curriculum is a blend of Research and Practice with suitable interdisciplinary avenues for the students to specialize and take forward.

One of the most sought after institute by students in North India, it aspires to create self-motivated, creative and industry ready professionals. As we strive to elevate the institute standards, focus is placed on Industry-academia collaborative practices, along with a strong connect to the roots of our diversely splendid country. 
--
 
 As part of the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan, a Cleanliness and Awareness Drive will be organized at the Faculty of Architecture & Planning (FOAP), AKTU, Lucknow.
 
 The initiative aims to promote cleanliness, environmental awareness, responsible waste management, and a greener campus. Faculty members, staff, and students will come together to actively participate in keeping the campus clean and creating awareness about sustainable practices.

 FOAP Campus, Lucknow
